text.offer: Priestess Themala hums a low note. "Will you lend your voice to the Lady of Song? Every voice raised makes her music carry further. Sing these words with me: By the song that was before the world, I call to thee, Jala, Lady of Song."
text.progress: The realm's shrines stand in the Forest Shrine past Marion, the Badlands beyond Barloque, the orc caves beyond Tos, the necromancers' arena at Brax and the citizen's market of Barloque. Drop the offering on the ground beside one.
text.complete: Every bard in the land sings truer today, and it is your doing. Come back tomorrow, and we will sing again.

steps.brief: Hear how it hums? That is the Lady's song, caught in a bottle of mystic perfume. Leave it at one of the realm's shrines, and for a day the shrine will sing for Jala.
